info.title: bet-agg HTTP API
info.description: Prediction service; public JSON under `/api/bet/*` plus `/api/openapi.json` and `/up`. Auth to **bet-agg** is **`X-User-Access-Token` only** (raw JWT, no Bearer prefix): copy the user token into this header upstream; **`Authorization` is not validated** for foundation user login on these routes (Bearer is reserved for other gateways). `POST /api/bet/snowflake` mints `data.id` for `X-Request-Id` on `POST /api/bet/place` (idempotency). Responses use ApiResponse envelope: `data`, `errorCode`, `message`, `_req_id`.

UserAccessToken.name: X-User-Access-Token
UserAccessToken.description: Foundation user JWT (raw). Required for authenticated bet routes.

id.description: Decimal snowflake; send as X-Request-Id on place.

balance.description: User points score (non-redeemable in current flows).

side_a_icon.description: OSS object key for side A subject emblem (e.g. subj_icon/{uuid}.png).

side_b_icon.description: OSS object key for side B subject emblem.

starts_at.description: Scheduled start time (epoch millis) from CMS.

get.description: Crowd pick distribution per market, in request order. Unknown markets return an empty snapshot.
Time-bucketed crowd pick distribution. Default window is the last 7 days ending at `to` (or now).
